when.en: A page, flow, or surface that does not exist yet must be created; the person named the target route and its business promise is known or will be decided first.
when.vi: Một trang, luồng hay bề mặt chưa tồn tại cần được tạo; người dùng nêu route đích, lời hứa nghiệp vụ đã có hoặc sẽ được quyết trước.

mission.goal: a new surface exists, is proven and is published

doneWhen.evidence: the promise the surface carries is published
the surface is committed on the session branch
the committed head is served on the product port
the served surface passes the audit with its screenshots kept
a person's journey completes on the served surface
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: frontend.direction.decide + frontend.presentation.resolve + frontend.source.apply → interface.generate; the post-write workspace.bind (runtimeNeed consume) → runtime.serve; frontend.surface.audit → interface.audit.
